Contemporary Yonhap reports list 산업자원부 among the seven new ministries whose 장·차관 posts were vacant until the 1998-03-03 cabinet, so no 산업자원부 spell is created for 정해주. The day-level end 1998-02-27 follows offices.json (통상산업부 to 1998-02-27). The ministry page (to 1998-03-03) and Wikipedia (to 1998-03-02) count his tenure up to the new cabinet. Birth date and gender were not found in a saved source. Verifier: 연합뉴스 1997-11-19 spells the given name 鄭海주(삼수변에舟), i.e. 洀, which confirms the hanja 鄭海洀. Namu Wiki's 鄭海週 is wrong. 매일경제 1998-03-04 reports that the old ministers, who had been on standby, held their farewells on 1998-03-03. This is a de facto caretaker period, not a legal tenure in 산업자원부 (the 1998 law excludes 정무직 from the staff transfer).

issues.desc: 1998-02-28..1998-03-02. 법률 제5529호 turned 통상산업부 into 산업자원부 on the afternoon of 1998-02-28. 연합뉴스 1998-02-28 (13:29 and 15:27) reports that the 장·차관 posts of the seven new ministries, 산업자원부 included, were vacant until the new cabinet, and 서울신문 1998-03-02 headlines '7부처 장관 공석'. The roster therefore ends 정해주 (통상산업부) on 1998-02-27 and leaves 산업자원부 vacant until 박태영 on 1998-03-03. The ministry page (정해주 to 1998-03-03) and ko.wikipedia (to 1998-03-02) instead count 정해주 through the change. No acting head existed for these three days. 경향신문 1998-03-02 reports that the seven new ministries, 산업자원부 included, ran for a second day '장관과 차관이 없는 조직으로', and 한국경제 1998-03-02 reports the 장관 posts of the seven renamed ministries 궐위 (BigKinds metadata, roster/sources/industry/news/bigkinds_2f08271d59.json, query '산업자원부 장관 공석' 1998-02-27..03-04). A downstream rule that treats YS-era ministers as caretakers of the renamed offices would add a 정해주 산업자원부 spell 1998-02-28..1998-03-02 (reorg_continuation=true, reappointed_on_reorg=false).

윤진식 end. News on 2003-12-15/16 (전자신문, MBN, 머니투데이, 경향신문) reports the resignation accepted on 2003-12-15, the ministry page lists 2003-12-17 and Wikipedia 2003-12-16. The successor's gazette date is 2003-12-17, so the roster has a one-day vacancy on 2003-12-16 with no acting head named in a saved source. The 차관 김칠두 (appointed 2003-03-03 per 관보 제15340호) was in office that day. 경인일보 2003-12-17 has '김칠두 산업자원부 차관' accompanying the PM on 2003-12-16 and 머니투데이 2003-12-18 has him at an event on 2003-12-18 (BigKinds metadata, roster/sources/industry/news/bigkinds_6a376809c7.json). No source calls him 장관 직무대행, so the acting list stays empty.

정세균 end and the 2007-01-04..2007-01-28 vacancy. The resignation was to be accepted on 2007-01-03 and his farewell was that afternoon (머니투데이, 한국경제, 연합뉴스 2007-01-03), and 부산일보 2007-01-03 reports it accepted that day. The ministry page gives 2007-01-04. The successor 김영주 was appointed on 2007-01-29 (gazette). No saved source names an acting minister for 2007-01-04..2007-01-28. The 제1차관 김종갑 (appointed 2006-02-01, 관보 제16188호) and the 제2차관 이원걸 were in office throughout. 한국경제 2007-01-04 and 서울경제 2007-01-16 name both 차관 (roster/sources/industry/news/naver_015_0000937929.html, naver_011_0000166377.html), and 뉴시스 2007-01-22 has '김종갑 산업자원부 제1차관' at the President's meeting with the Saudi oil minister (naver_003_0000294583.html).
